findings: Cropin Technology Solutions Pvt. Ltd. holds an issued patent (US11263707B2) filed in 2018 for a machine learning-based crop prediction system that processes geographic and agronomic data to optimize crop production.

The company reports the rollout of the "akṣara" micro language model in April 2024 as an open-source, resource-frugal AI solution for climate-smart agriculture in South Asia, followed by the July 2026 launch of "OrbitAI," an agentic AI decision engine developed in partnership with Google Cloud using Gemini models and Google Earth Engine to provide geospatial and climate analytics.

We verified that the company possesses a strong, documented baseline of technical innovation, establishing proprietary domain models, cloud platforms, and agentic AI architectures integrated with planetary-scale geospatial and satellite data pipelines.
